text:
taylor: Quick sync thread on follow-ups from yesterday's outage cluster (multi-region control-plane spike + model-registry 401s + Okta throttling). Need owners, concrete short-term mitigations, and a timeline. I'll open a tracker after we agree.

javier: I can take the model-registry/auth piece. Root cause looks like our token refresh worker crashed during a KMS key rotation, causing a burst of 401s. Short-term: add cached-token fallback + alert on token-refresh errors. ETA: 3 business days for patch + deploy.

megan: I'll take the Okta throttling side. Short-term patch: add exponential backoff + log rate-limit headers so we can measure remaining quotas. Long-term: per-tenant request queuing and telemetry. Short-term ETA: 2 business days for backoff patch, long-term ETA: 3 weeks.

laura: I'm on provider engagement (Azure/AWS contacts). I'll ask for a provider postmortem and push for a credit/SLA clause if we see repeated control-plane interruptions. ETA: initial outreach by EOD, follow-up in 10 business days.

ops-bot: Created tracker EDRW-145: https://redwood.internal/incidents/EDRW-145 (title: vendor-dep-mitigations & follow-ups). Owners please add checklist items.

 taylor: Short-term mitigations checklist (<=2w) I want in the ticket now: client retry+jitters, cached token fallback, emergency read-only mode for model-registry, per-route circuit-breaker for control-plane errors.

javier: Sample alert I'll add to prometheus for the token problem:

  alert: ModelRegistryHTTP401Spike
  expr: increase(model_registry_http_responses{code="401"}[10m]) > 50
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical

megan: Adding a logging header capture to Okta proxy so we can report x-rate-limit-remaining and x-rate-limit-reset. Quick patch will log these fields and increment a metric.

laura: For provider-side resilience: I'm proposing a temporary routing policy to prefer regions with lower recent control-plane error rates and a failover list. We should include this as a short-term rollback knob if we see repeat spikes.

javier: Preventative control suggestion: add a pre-rotation canary that rotates 1% of service account keys and validates refresh flows before full rotation. Add to runbook.

megan: Also recommending a monthly "external-dep smoke" job that runs critical auth + model-registry flows and emits a regression metric. I'll own the first run and post results in two weeks.

infra-bot: KMS audit requested (ticket INFRA-709). Scheduled scan ETA: 5 business days.

 taylor: Please append these exact checklist lines to EDRW-145 and set timeboxes (short-term = sprint / <=2w, long-term = quarter). I'll collate and present at next ops sync. Sample checklist lines to paste:

  - [ ] javier 84 model-registry cached-token fallback + alerting 84 ETA 3d
  - [ ] megan 84 Okta backoff + rate-limit logging 84 ETA 2d (patch), 3w (full)
  - [ ] laura 84 provider engagement + routing fallback plan 84 ETA EOD outreach, 10d follow-up
  - [ ] infra 84 KMS rotation audit (INFRA-709) 84 ETA 5d (infra-bot)
  - [ ] ops 84 monthly external-dep smoke job 84 ETA 14d (megan owns first run)

javier: Claimed and starting work on branch now. Will post PR link when ready.

megan: Backoff patch will be canaried behind a feature flag. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h. Adding rollout note to EDRW-145.

laura: Reached out to provider L2 contact. They confirmed incident correlation and will provide timeline. I'll paste provider PM notes to the ticket when received.

 taylor: Two operational asks before we close this thread: 1) each owner add one "preventative control" short line to the checklist (things that would have prevented this), 2) tag any related alerts with label external_dep: true so regression detectors can surface trends.

megan: Added preventative control: log & metric capture of provider rate-limit headers + automatic per-tenant throttling hysteresis.

javier: Added preventative control: pre-rotation canary + healthcheck gate to runbook.

ops-bot: EDRW-145 updated with checklist and statuses. Next review scheduled at weekly ops sync.

 taylor: Thanks all. Closing thread 28 please update EDRW-145 ASAP and include PR links / runbook edits. We'll triage recurrence patterns in next ops sync. :thumbsup:
